text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, make a clear plan and break big tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important: decide which tasks are most urgent and do them first. If you have too much work, use scope management. This means you may need to reduce what you do or focus only on the most important parts. Finally, communication matters. If you think you cannot finish on time, tell your team or teacher early. They may help you or give you more time. With planning and honesty, deadlines become easier to manage.
